## Pushed for review — Gerrit change 1005

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1005 (commit `ec1c2b03b`, 16 files, +606/-36).

Plan review earned a signed attestation on run 4 (PASS, 0 blocking, 2 advisory P6/P7, 0 dropped)
after three BLOCK rounds; ticket claimed and the change is now awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and
`Verified +1`.

Local verification before push:
- `make lint` clean (ruff check + format-check + zizmor + actionlint)
- `make typecheck` clean — 381 source files
- `pytest tests/unit tests/interfaces` — **6,967 passed, 31 skipped, 0 failed** (10m19s)
- module-size cap respected; largest touched file `workflow_ops.py` at 785 / 800 LOC
- `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` → OK; DCO sign-off + Change-Id present

Two Gerrit commit-message style warnings (subject >50 chars, body lines >72) — advisory only, the
push succeeded.

**Not closing this ticket yet.** Per AGENTS.md the change must be `Verified +1` and MERGED, and this
worktree fast-forwarded, before `transition ... closed`. A passing completion-verifier is not a
substitute for green CI.

Follow-up filed: task f391-5a20-4593-4405 (resolvable-wavy-avocet), linked `discovered_from` this
story — the `undecomposed` axis fires on 12/18,085 plan-v3 findings (0.07%) while holding full
hard-override power. Analysis-only; may legitimately close as 'correct residual'.
